description: Ember's table is recipes/fast's, plus one phase: an intake seat ahead of implement, so a one-line chore request is framed once instead of re-derived by every seat after it. Every review, residual and ship rule below intake is inherited byte-for-byte from fast, including decision 0022's reforging ladder — a frugal recipe buys cheaper seats, never a cheaper constitution.

rules.reason: Task framed against the repo and recorded.
